+from pypika import Table, Query
+
+def test_table_select():
+    t = Table('my_table')
+    # This should fail currently because Table has no select method
+    try:
+        q1 = t.select(t.x, t.y)
+        print("t.select worked")
+    except AttributeError as e:
+        print(f"t.select failed as expected: {e}")
+
+    q2 = Query.from_(t).select(t.x, t.y)
+    print(f"Query.from_(t).select: {q2}")
+
+    if 'q1' in locals() and q1:
+        print(f"t.select result: {q1}")
+        assert str(q1) == str(q2)
+        print("Success: t.select == Query.from_(t).select")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    test_table_select()
